body: Cutter Gauthier keeps finding the net. The Ducks forward scored in the first period of a 6-1 win over the Calgary Flames on Nov. 15, stretching his goal streak to nine games, the longest by any NHL player in 29 years.

His 18 goals through 20 games match Auston Matthews for the most by an active American player at that point of a season, and his 11-game point streak, with 20 points, is a career best. He is also only the fifth player aged 22 or younger to score in nine straight games.
